title: Cheddar & Onion Baked Irish Boxty
steps: Boil half the potatoes (cut into chunks) for 15 minutes. Gently fry onion in cooking spray until lightly browned.
Grate remaining raw potatoes into a sieve; squeeze out liquid with kitchen paper.
Drain boiled potatoes; mash with milk and salt until smooth.
Stir in grated raw potato, flour, then fried onion and cheese until combined.
Line a flan dish with parchment; spray. Add mixture; smooth top; score into quarters; spray.
Bake 35 minutes until golden and crisp. Slice into quarters and serve hot.
notes: Try adding herbs or spring onions for extra flavour. Serve with a fried egg or beans.
source: The Slimming Foodie by Pip Payne (2021)
